req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-003 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string. We need: (1) a positive case confirming a valid string title returns 201, (2) negative cases for each non-string type (integer, boolean, null, array, object) returning 422, and (3) boundary cases at the edge of valid/invalid type coercion. The test suite covers EP (valid vs invalid type partitions), NEG (each non-string type), BVA (numeric 0 and 1 which Pydantic might coerce), and DT (decision table across type variants). All tests use exact status code assertions and inspect response body fields to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with title as a valid non-empty string
expected: Response body contains id, title matching input, completed=false
trace: R-TASK-003: valid string title must succeed (positive partition)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Valid string title", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Valid string title"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] >= 21

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import json

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_non_string_does_not_create_record():
    r_post = client.post(
        "/tasks/",
        content=json.dumps({"title": 99, "completed": False}),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )
    assert r_post.status_code == 422
    r_get = client.get("/tasks/?limit=1000")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    tasks = r_get.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 20
